value: Art of Living Teacher · President, Indian Yoga Association

With over 30 years of dedicated experience, Mahesh Bhaiya has been spreading the love, wisdom and vision of Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar across the globe, touching lives in countries like China, Cambodia, Malaysia and many more.

He currently serves as the President of the Indian Yoga Association. Since the pandemic, he has been consistently conducting Daily Online Sri Sri Yoga Classes, guiding thousands towards better health, peace and inner transformation.

He was honoured as "Yoga Teacher of the Month" in the October edition of the Art of Living Foundation Magazine.

A Textile Engineer by profession — once he used to fix clothes, today he beautifully fixes smiles, energies and lives. From the Happiness Program to VTP and TTP, he has transformed countless lives. His service has reached institutions like the Indian Space Research Organisation, the Army, Air Force, Paramilitary Forces, corporates, and youth across rural and urban India.
